description: 市営自転車駐車場一覧 [cycling networks] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 浦安市. 市営自転車駐車場の一覧. Coverage: 浦安市. The portal files it under the publisher 浦安市. Its tags are 浦安市, 自転車駐車場. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
